title: Unit 6: Best Friends: Friendship, Have to & Don't Have to
objective: Mampu berbicara tentang kejadian di masa lampau, menjelaskan apa yang disukai dilakukan sendiri maupun bersama orang lain, membicarakan teman dan persahabatan, serta menggunakan past simple (irregular verbs), double genitive, dan past simple questions

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menceritakan kejadian masa lalu menggunakan past simple dengan kata kerja tidak beraturan (irregular verbs). Kamu akan belajar membentuk kalimat positif, negatif, dan pertanyaan tentang masa lalu. Selain itu, ada konsep double genitive untuk menyatakan kepemilikan (a friend of mine), serta ungkapan waktu lampau seperti yesterday, last week, dan ago.
rules: Past Simple (Irregular Verbs) - Positif: Subject + Verb 2 (contoh: She liked singing. They went to Rome. He became famous.)
Past Simple (Irregular Verbs) - Negatif: Subject + didn't + Verb 1 (contoh: We didn't go to Rome. Jonathan didn't think for long.)
Past Simple Questions: Did + Subject + Verb 1...? (contoh: Did you have a good weekend? What time did you get home?)
Double Genitive: a/an + noun + of + possessive (contoh: a friend of mine, a teacher of my sister's, a neighbour of ours)
Past Time Expressions: yesterday, last night, last week, two weeks ago, a month ago, when I was sixteen (contoh: Andy left school four years ago.)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Verb 1 pada Past Simple Positif
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa mengubah kata kerja menjadi bentuk lampau (verb 2) pada kalimat positif past simple, atau sebaliknya menggunakan verb 2 setelah 'didn't' pada kalimat negatif.
commonTrap.wrong: They go to Rome last year. / He didn't went to school yesterday.
commonTrap.correct: They went to Rome last year. / He didn't go to school yesterday.

dialogue.context: Artikel majalah tentang bagaimana Richard dan Sharon bertemu dan menjadi teman baik setelah Sharon menyelamatkan Richard dari kecelakaan surfing di pantai Bondi, Sydney

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: So first of all, when and where did you meet?
lines.translation: Jadi pertama-tama, kapan dan di mana kalian bertemu?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: We first met in 2012, one morning at about 10.30 am on Bondi Beach, in Sydney.
lines.translation: Kami pertama kali bertemu pada 2012, suatu pagi sekitar jam 10.30 di Pantai Bondi, Sydney.

lines.speaker: Sharon
lines.text: Actually, we met in the water.
lines.translation: Sebenarnya, kami bertemu di dalam air.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: OK, so how did you meet?

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: I was out in the deep water on my surfboard when another board knocked me on the head. The next thing I knew, I was on the beach looking up at this face.
lines.translation: Saya sedang di air dalam dengan papan selancar saya ketika papan lain menabrak kepala saya. Hal berikutnya yang saya ingat, saya ada di pantai melihat ke atas wajah ini.

lines.speaker: Sharon
lines.text: I was on the beach that day. I saw what happened so I swam out and brought Richard back in. He was unconscious, but luckily I got him to start breathing again. But for a minute I thought he was dead.
lines.translation: Saya ada di pantai hari itu. Saya melihat apa yang terjadi jadi saya berenang keluar dan membawa Richard kembali. Dia tidak sadar, tapi untungnya saya bisa membuatnya bernapas lagi. Tapi untuk sesaat saya pikir dia sudah mati.

lines.speaker: Richard
lines.text: And then they took me to hospital. I didn't have a chance to even say thanks to Sharon.
lines.translation: Dan kemudian mereka membawa saya ke rumah sakit. Saya tidak punya kesempatan bahkan untuk berterima kasih pada Sharon.

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalaman berteman dan kejadian masa lalu menggunakan past simple

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hi! Let's talk about your friends. When did you meet your best friend?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I met my best friend five years ago at school.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful! What do you like doing together with your friends?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I like going shopping with friends. I don't like going alone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Great! Now tell me about a great present someone gave you. What was it and when did they give it to you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Last year my friend gave me a book. I was really happy because I love reading.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! One more question - did you have a good weekend? What did you do?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I did. I completed four levels in my favorite game and I met my best friend.

quiz.question: Charlotte and Jonathan _____ the competition, but they _____ second place.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat negatif past simple menggunakan 'didn't + verb 1' (didn't win), sedangkan kalimat positif menggunakan verb 2 (came). Jangan gunakan verb 2 setelah didn't.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses the double genitive correctly?
quiz.explanation: Double genitive menggunakan pola 'a/an + noun + of + possessive' seperti 'a friend of mine', bukan 'of me' atau posisi possessive yang salah.

quiz.question: _____ you _____ a good time at the party last night?
quiz.explanation: Past simple questions menggunakan 'Did + subject + verb 1'. Setelah 'Did' selalu gunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja (have), bukan verb 2 (had).

quiz.question: Which personality adjective means 'always ready to help you'?
quiz.explanation: Helpful berarti suka menolong, selalu siap membantu. Jealous berarti cemburu, sedangkan confident berarti percaya diri.

quiz.question: Complete: 'I had breakfast _____ 7 o'clock this morning.'
quiz.explanation: Untuk menyatakan waktu spesifik (jam), gunakan preposisi 'at'. Contoh: at 7 o'clock, at midnight, at 10.20.

quiz.question: They _____ together as a duo. They also _____ very good friends.
quiz.explanation: Bentuk past simple dari 'sing' adalah 'sang' (irregular verb), dan dari 'become' adalah 'became'. Tidak ada bentuk 'singed' atau 'becomed'.
